svg.title: All pinned RDNA2 instruction forms: conversion and evidence
svg.desc: One square per instruction encoding. Green: accepted fixture subset; amber: recorded translation with acceptance pending; blue: decoder with evidence gap; gray: not converted. Full accessible table in shader-checklist.md.
